The available Freddy AI features are easy to learn and use. Great job there. :)

The one feature I find of use: Resolution generator. 

Other features that I do not find of use from Freddy AI:
--Using the Reply generator often freezes/crashes the system.
--Had to turn off the translator as Freddy auto-translated one of my replies to French and sent to user without my asking/approval. Unsure why the system felt the need to translate to French.
--I mistakenly thought Freddy AI would be able to help with Microsoft troubleshooting questions, we're a small help desk (2), we're unable to write solution articles for every Microsoft question that comes our way. It makes sense Freddy AI would only be able to help with company-specific solution articles.
--Allow Freddy to also read the Description field in tickets. Our previous ticketing system was dumped in to the Description field. Freddy is unable to learn from past tickets because Freddy can't read the Description field. I brought this up before and a data cleanup project was offered, but we are not interested in a data clean-up project to split the info from past tickets into Note fields.

Final thoughts:
I think Freddy would work better for a larger help desk. I think perhaps we are too small at this time to provide the needed pre-configuration knowledge base buildup to build Freddy AI up to work as intended. I see Freddy being of value to a larger team that can build up the foundational resources needed in the system to support Freddy's knowledge. |
